name: Hime-sama wa Princess
source:
Shinobu is a boy with cute face like a girl. One day, he starts working at a house as a live-in butler. Like this, his new life with Lucia, a beautiful princess, begins...

Lucia doesn't like men, but she gradually gets attracted to Shinobu's cute face. If Shinobu makes the right choices, he will have a happy life with her. However, if he makes a mistake, he will be fooled by Christine, a live-in housemaid, and Lucia will be also tricked into playing with him. It all depends on Shibonu if he will be the main character of a happy love story or a plaything of the girls...
